name: comp-23

frames.best_why: The field is filled with masked dots and the eye button and full field are clear, with no cursor on them.

tagline: A password box with an eye button meant to swap the dots for text.
summary: A labelled password field with a small eye button at its right edge. Typing hides the characters as dots, and the eye is meant to switch between masked and plain text.
appearance: A small label sits above a rounded dark field on a black stage, with a grey Password placeholder at the left and a faint eye outline inside the right edge. Once typing starts the placeholder gives way to a row of dots while the eye stays put.
behaviour: Clicking the field draws a pale ring and typing replaces the placeholder with dots. The eye button is built to toggle between hidden and visible text, but every frame keeps the entry masked.
demo_content: Label Show/hide password input with a Password placeholder and a masked entry.
search_phrases: eye icon to reveal a secret
hidden dots in a login field
show or hide what you typed
secret entry with a peek button
masked text that can be revealed
reveal button inside a text box
use_when: A password or secret entry where letting the user peek at what they typed reduces mistakes.
avoid_when: The eye is a small target inside the field, easy to miss on touch screens.
customise: The label and Password placeholder are fixed in the file; field and eye styling are classes there, and the visible state lives in a small useState.
weight_why: One field and one icon button with a single state flag; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.note: The eye is a labelled button with a pressed state, but its aria-controls points at an id the field never has.

issues: The eye's aria-controls names an id the input never receives, so the link is broken.
The clip never shows the password revealed, only masked dots in every frame.
polish_why: Neat field with a clear eye button, but the demo never proves the reveal works.
title: Password Visibility Toggle
